description: This Java class defines the RecurrenceInfo object, which manages recurrence patterns including rules, exception rules, start dates, and related recurrence logic for calendar events in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: RecurrenceInfo
classes.description: Main class managing recurrence patterns, rules, exception rules, and date lists for calendar events.

classes.name: RecurrenceWrapper
classes.description: Inner class extending TemporalExpression to adapt RecurrenceInfo to TemporalExpression interface.

methods.name: RecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing RecurrenceInfo from a GenericValue object.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes rules, exception rules, and date lists for this recurrence.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns the primary key identifier for this recurrence info.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the recurrence pattern.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start date as a long timestamp.

methods.name: getRecurrenceRuleIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the recurrence rules.

methods.name: getRecurrenceDateIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over recurrence dates.

methods.name: getExceptionRuleIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over exception recurrence rules.

methods.name: getExceptionDateIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over exception dates.

methods.name: getCurrentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of how many recurrences have occurred.

methods.name: incrementCurrentCount
methods.description: Increments the recurrence count and optionally stores it.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the recurrence and associated rules from persistence.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the first recurrence (start date).

methods.name: last
methods.description: Placeholder for calculating the last recurrence (not implemented).

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next recurrence timestamp from now.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next recurrence timestamp from a given time.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the current recurrence is valid.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if recurrence is valid at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the string primary key of the recurrence info.

methods.name: makeInfo
methods.description: Creates a new RecurrenceInfo with specified parameters (overloads for count or endTime).

methods.name: toTemporalExpression
methods.description: Converts a RecurrenceInfo object to a TemporalExpression.
